profile.entities: S&S Power Switchgear Limited; SSPSE; Acrastyle Limited; HART
profile.subseg: High Voltage Disconnectors; Industrial Control & Protection Systems
profile.themes: Green Aluminum Smelting Tech; Digital Twin Integration; Export Market Expansion

bull_bear.body: 1.0-1.25% of revenue to R&D; ESOPs for talent retention; proportional annual dividends; capex for capacity and tech; zero debt accumulation target by Mar 2028
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Execution risk on capex and international expansion; currency/foreign regulatory exposure; supply chain delays; competition from global players; reliance on aluminum industry demand; technology adoption pace
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: HART’s REDCon system for aluminum smelters is a proprietary, high-margin niche with limited global competition; Acrastyle’s UK presence provides regulatory credibility and export gateway to EU/UK markets
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Target to become debt-free by March 2028 and generate positive free cash flow.
- Fair proportional annual dividends to shareholders planned as part of sharing success.
- ESOPs offered to attract and retain talent, alongside modern work environments and positive work culture.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: SSPSE: 36kV-765kV disconnectors, retrofits, spares; Acrastyle: protection & control panels for aluminum smelters; HART: customized hardware/software for aluminum plants, including POT controllers and FIRECon systems
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Client-centricity and customization for different site conditions are core, providing built-to-suit retrofit solutions that extend equipment lifespan and lower total cost of ownership.
- The group leverages in-depth engineering expertise and superior customer service standards to differentiate, with a legacy of over 50,000 disconnectors deployed in 50 countries.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] HART (Hamilton Research & Technology) acquired in 2024, adding customized hardware/software solutions for aluminum plants worldwide.
- [Management] New management team inducted starting Feb 2024, including MD & Group CEO Krishnakumar Ramanathan (ex-Siemens) and new CEOs for each subsidiary.
- [IPR] Target to create 1-2 strong IPRs per company per year.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin improved to 4.8% in FY26 (from 2.7% in FY25); cost optimization via lean manufacturing, streamlined PM/CM/SCM, and zero overdue payments driving margin expansion
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Target doubling FY25 revenue by FY28; EBITDA margin of 12-15%; positive free cash flow; zero overdue payments; 1-2 tech acquisitions; 1.0-1.25% revenue invested in R&D; fair dividends; zero deviation in EHS/compliance.
outlook.title: Guidance / outlook

outlook.body: All-time high backlog; international order from Egypt (Apr 2026); 765kV disconnector orders commercialized (Jan 2026)
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Expansion into Vietnam, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Africa, Middle East; global exhibitions in Kenya, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Tanzania; potential tech acquisitions; digital twin and AI in design/engineering; UK market penetration
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: S&S Power is transforming from a legacy switchgear manufacturer into a technology-led global player in high-voltage disconnectors and industrial automation, leveraging strategic capex, export growth, and proprietary systems like REDCon to capture high-margin niches in aluminum and energy sectors. With FY26 revenue up 43% and EBITDA margins expanding, it's on track to double revenue by FY28 while targeting 12-15% EBITDA and debt-free status.
